name: @pipeworx/mcp-replicate

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all public models available on Replicate, paginated via cursor; returns owner, name, description, run count, and latest version id for each model.

tools.name: model
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a specific Replicate model by owner and name, including description, visibility, run count, latest version, and GitHub URL.

tools.name: model_versions
tools.description: List all published versions of a Replicate model by owner and name; returns version ids, creation timestamps, and input/output schema for each version.

tools.name: model_version
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a specific Replicate model version by owner, name, and version_id, including the complete input/output OpenAPI schema and Cog version.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search public Replicate models by keyword query; returns matching models with owner, name, description, and run count.

tools.name: collections
tools.description: List all curated Replicate model collections (e.g. "text-to-image", "speech-to-text"); returns collection slug, name, and description.

tools.name: collection
tools.description: Fetch models belonging to a specific Replicate collection by slug (e.g. "text-to-image"); returns the collection description and a list of model objects.

tools.name: create_prediction
tools.description: Start a Replicate model run by submitting a version id and input object; returns a prediction id and status that can be polled with the prediction tool until output is ready.

tools.name: prediction
tools.description: Poll the status and retrieve output for a Replicate prediction by id; returns status (starting/processing/succeeded/failed/canceled), output URLs, and logs.

tools.name: list_predictions
tools.description: List your recent Replicate predictions in reverse chronological order, paginated via cursor; returns prediction id, model version, status, and creation timestamp.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List your Replicate model deployments (dedicated, auto-scaled endpoints), paginated via cursor; returns owner, name, current model version, and scaling config.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Fetch your Replicate account details including username, name, GitHub URL, and account type.

tools.name: hardware
tools.description: List available Replicate hardware types (CPU, GPU SKUs) with their names and SKU identifiers; use to select hardware when creating a deployment.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-replicate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the replicate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
